name: Yawn Mower
description: A fuzzy, hooky indie-rock band and a fixture of the Asbury Park scene for about a decade, signed to Mint 400 Records. They were the 2025 Makin Waves Band of the Year and won Established Band at the 2025 Asbury Park Music Awards.
activity: Played a July 16, 2026 show with Black Flamingos; sophomore LP 'I Just Can't Wait to Die' came out in 2025.

name: Surfing For Daisy
description: This band started on an Asbury Park porch and plays alt-folk-rock with psychedelic touches. They swept the band categories at the 2025 Asbury Park Music Awards, winning Emerging Band, Live Band and Album of the Year.
activity: Released 'Echo The Madness' on Bandcamp on Sept 25, 2026; played Sea.Hear.Now in 2025.

name: Dogs In A Pile
description: A young Asbury Park jam-band quintet that has moved from Jersey Shore bars to national tours, playing improvisational rock in the Phish/Grateful Dead tradition.
activity: Played the Stone Pony Summer Stage in Aug 2026 and toured that fall, with 2027 dates already announced.

name: Teen Idle
description: An indie-rock band led by singer-songwriter Sara Abdelbarry, mixing big guitars with tender, melodic songwriting. They were nominated for Established Band at the 2025 Asbury Park Music Awards.
activity: Released the album 'A Heart So Tender' on May 1, 2026.

name: Waiting On Mongo
description: An eight-piece funk and jam band with horns that plays both originals and covers, built for dancing. Their first full-length album was 'From the Top' (2024).
activity: Nominated for Established Band at the 2025 Asbury Park Music Awards, held Feb 2026 at the Stone Pony.

name: The Foes of Fern
description: An Asbury Park supergroup of scene veterans that plays melodic, Shore-flavored rock. Their LP 'Carpe Diem' took four years to make.
activity: Nominated for Established Band at the 2025 Asbury Park Music Awards, held Feb 2026.

name: Heavy Mouth
description: A guitar-driven Asbury Park indie band from the city's DIY and small-club circuit, often booked at spots like Low Dive.
activity: Released the single 'Blind to Sound' on June 26, 2026; played Low Dive with Jackson Pines in May 2025.

name: Williams Honor
description: A country-rock duo, Reagan Richards and Gordon Brown, that came out of the Asbury Park scene and splits its time between the Shore and Nashville.
activity: Played Light of Day Winterfest at the Stone Pony and Count Basie Center in Jan 2026, then Klose Amphitheater in Long Branch in July 2026.

name: Ocean Avenue Stompers
description: A high-energy brass band that mixes New Orleans second-line horns with funk, jazz and Asbury rock 'n' roll. They play clubs, parades and private events around the Shore.
activity: Top winner at the 27th annual Makin Waves Awards in Dec 2025, with three awards.

name: Black Flamingos
description: An instrumental surf trio with reverb-soaked guitar, tied to Asbury's Hi-Tide Recordings. They have shared stages with Dick Dale, The Ventures and Los Straitjackets.
activity: Played with Yawn Mower on July 16, 2026.

name: Status Green
description: A 2000s-era Asbury Park pop-rock band with synth touches that has reunited and is playing big local stages again.
activity: Played a 20th-anniversary show at the Stone Pony in Nov 2025 and was on the Sea.Hear.Now 2026 lineup (Sept 2026).

name: Brian Kirk & the Jirks
description: A long-running Jersey Shore party band with a deep roster of musicians, playing rock, soul and dance covers at summer concerts, weddings and events.
activity: Played Ramapo College's 2026 summer concert series (moved to Aug 20, 2026).

name: all under heaven
description: A Freehold shoegaze band that layers walls of guitar over emo and grunge-tinged melodies, released through Sunday Drive Records.
activity: Released a split 7-inch with High in June 2025, following the 2024 LP 'What Lies Ahead Of Me'.

name: Dr Scientist
description: A Morristown act whose songs pair laid-back pop with rowdy rock 'n' roll, with a catalog of EPs and LPs going back a decade.
activity: Released the album 'It Hurts' in Oct 2025.

name: LORES
description: A North Jersey prog-rock band that writes story-driven songs about myth and fantasy, including a concept album, 'Book I: Panthalassa'.
activity: Released the single 'No Resolution' on Sept 19, 2026.

name: Psychic Wars
description: A five-piece Collingswood band with two singers that plays riff-heavy psych rock with shoegaze and post-punk shading.
activity: Released the album 'Takers' in Jan 2025, followed by a Gradwell House live-session release.
